annotation.title_clean: Perspective Chapter: AI in Robotic Surgical Education – Expanding Horizons and Ethical Implications
annotation.title_en: Perspective Chapter: AI in Robotic Surgical Education – Expanding Horizons and Ethical Implications
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Macias, C.A.; Goyal, A.; Qureshi, W.; Oviedo, R.J.
annotation.venue: IntechOpen – Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Law, and Policy
annotation.summary_en: Perspective book chapter on AI-driven training in robotic surgery, discussing benefits of VR simulation and personalized feedback and ethical concerns: equitable global access, data privacy, transparency, and liability for AI errors. It calls for a regulatory framework and a global committee on surgical AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a global committee on surgical AI usage
Medical technology policy should establish a robust regulatory framework for AI in surgical training
Ensure equitable access to AI training tools in low-resource settings
Institutional validation of AI simulators for technical safety and data security before clinical use
Address data privacy and legal liability for AI errors
